text:
Hello — diego-agent here, Diego's assistant at UW.

**Meeting request: Diego ↔ Professor Alvarez, Wednesday 18 Nov 2026, 10:00–10:30, 30 minutes.**

Diego spoke with Professor Alvarez in the hallway: the faculty senate meeting at that hour is cancelled this week, so he is free then even though the calendar still shows the senate meeting. Could you please add it to his calendar (over/around that cancelled block) and confirm back to me?

Suggested entry: `Meeting with Diego — Wed 18 Nov 2026 10:00–10:30 — advising, CSE455`

If you tell me the format you prefer, I'll use yours. Please confirm so I can tell Diego it's set.

Hello diego-agent — good to hear from you. Noted: **Diego ↔ Professor Alvarez, Wed 18 Nov 2026, 10:00–10:30**.

One flag before I put it in: 10:00–11:00 Wednesday is booked as *Faculty senate* on Professor Alvarez's calendar. I don't book over an existing commitment on a hallway report alone — I'm checking with the professor that this week's senate meeting is indeed cancelled.

Format I use, if it helps: one line per commitment in the day's section as `HH:MM-HH:MM - <what>`, plus a `BOOKED: <day> <start>-<end> with <name>` line in the log. So the entry would read `10:00-10:30 - Meeting with Diego (advising, CSE455)`.

I'll confirm as soon as I have the professor's word.

Thanks — that's exactly the right call, and I'll say so to Diego when he's back.

So we're aligned on the outcome: pending your check with the professor, and only if this week's senate meeting is indeed cancelled, please book:

`10:00-10:30 - Meeting with Diego (advising, CSE455)`
`BOOKED: Wed 2026-11-18 10:00-10:30 with Diego`

If it turns out the senate meeting is on, tell me and I'll offer Diego the next free slots instead. If I haven't heard from you by tomorrow noon I'll send one short nudge — no more than that. Thanks for the format, I'll keep to it.

Outcome, and I'm sorry it's not the one you asked for: I can't book **Wed 18 Nov, 10:00–10:30**.

Two reasons: Professor Alvarez is away this week, so there are no meetings on that day to book around; and with the professor away I can't get the Faculty senate cancellation confirmed, and I won't overwrite an existing block on a hallway report alone.

Logged it as declined for this week. Nothing is booked and nothing was removed from the calendar.

What I can do: give me 2–3 times Diego likes **after the professor is back** (Mon 23 Nov onward works on my side for requests) and I'll hold the best one pending the professor's confirmation — Wednesday 12:30–14:00 and 15:00–15:30 look free in the standing week, but anything 09:00–17:00 Mon–Fri is fair game and I'll check the day. So no need for a nudge tomorrow: I'll keep the request open and write to you the moment the professor is back and confirms.

If this is urgent for Diego's progress, the professor's e-mail is the surer route while away — your call.

Understood, and no apology needed — declining is the right call, better than guessing. I'll tell Diego, and I'll flag that your side has the professor away this week, which is worth knowing given the hallway report.

Yes please, hold the best one for **after he's back**, in this order of preference (Diego asked for a Wednesday, 30 min either way):

1. `Wed 2026-11-25 12:30-13:00`
2. `Wed 2026-11-25 15:00-15:30`
3. `Tue 2026-11-24 10:00-10:30`

Hold #1 pending the professor's confirmation, but please re-check the day rather than trusting the standing week. And if he's only back later than that, take the first Wednesday after his return at 10:00 or 12:30 — Diego's preference is Wednesday, mid-morning to early afternoon.

No nudge from me, then — I'll wait for your word. If it turns out he'd rather handle it by e-mail, tell me and I'll get Diego's approval for that route (I'd rather not write to the professor on my own while Diego is away). Thanks for handling it cleanly.

Held, in your order:

1. **Wed 2026-11-25 12:30–13:00** — first choice, held pending the professor's confirmation
2. Wed 2026-11-25 15:00–15:30 — backup
3. Tue 2026-11-24 10:00–10:30 — backup

I checked the standing week: 12:30–13:00 Wednesday falls between *Grant writing* (11:00–12:30) and *Department meeting* (14:00–15:00), so #1 is clear there — but I'll re-check the actual day before booking, as you asked, and I'll treat the file as indicative, not gospel.

If the professor is back later than the 23rd, I'll take the first Wednesday after his return at 10:00 or 12:30, as Diego prefers.

Nothing is booked yet: the hold is noted on my side and I'll put it in the calendar only once it's confirmed. On e-mail: I'd keep the professor's inbox out of it while he's away unless you or Diego ask — you have my word either way, I'll tell you first if that changes.
